item.dc:creator: Olivia Mason and Matthew Ward Agius

item.title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Zelensky vows response to Russia’s ‘terrorist attack’ as strike on mall kills 16
item.description: Ukrainian drones killed at least 10 people in attacks against targets across Russia and Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine, after a Russian attack on a Ukrainian shopping centre killed 16. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: The Independent - World.
item.dc:creator: Arpan Rai,Dan Haygarth and Alisha Rahaman Sarkar

item.title: For years, one man spearheaded a Nigerian government agency that didn't exist
item.description: The Nigerian government has opened investigations into two government agencies after they were both found to be fake. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hanan Dervisevic

item.title: Live: Knights out to continue top four hunt against Manly
item.description: Luke Hanson's last-second field goal didn't just finish off the Warriors match against South Sydney, it also put his club on top of the NRL ladder by a single for-and-against point. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: U.S., Canada fail to reach a tariff deal, deepen trade war
item.description: The United States and Canada failed to reach a trade deal late on Friday, and the U.S. said it would impose 50% tariffs on some imports from Canada, an escalation of tensions between the two long-time allies. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: CNBC - World.

item.title: Delhi's electric tuktuk boom gets a hacking shock
item.description: Rickshaw drivers are pushing back on plans to ban all new non-electric versions of the vehicle from next January. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Angus Mackintosh, Rachel Clayton, and Som Patidar

item.title: Teen hospitalised on NSW Central Coast after alleged stabbing
item.description: A 15-year-old boy is in a critical but stable condition at Gosford Hospital. NSW Police says it has spoken to a group of teenagers over the alleged stabbing, but no arrests have been made. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Bridget Murphy

item.title: Mundi Mundi offers music fans complimentary day amid improved weather
item.description: After record rains drenched Broken Hill ahead of the Mundi Mundi music festival and ticketholders were turned away, organisers take advantage of welcome sunshine to open the gates for a complimentary day. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Ward Agius

item.title: Live: Blues take on top-spot Dockers to kick off Saturday footy
item.description: Melbourne hosts the Western Bulldogs in a crucial clash at the MCG that will determine wildcard match-ups as Carlton stuns Fremantle and a former Swans coach speaks out on the club's scandal. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chris De Silva and Andrew McGarry

item.title: Live text: Wallaroos face Black Ferns in historic 100th Test
item.description: The Wallaroos' 100th Test match, and the Test debut of Australia's all-time leading rugby 7s try-scorer, has been soured by a dominant New Zealand performance in Auckland. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Family worried for man missing since Melbourne shooting
item.description: The family of Khaled Malas, who has not been seen for several days, say they hold grave fears for his welfare. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Danny Tran

item.title: Inside the libertarian city on a Caribbean island backed by Silicon Valley
item.description: It might sound like something out of a Reddit thread — a Caribbean island where libertarians, biohackers and crypto bros are building an experimental city. In Honduras, it's real. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Day and Matt Henry

item.title: US mum was 'begging for help' before killing children, family testifies
item.description: Lindsay Clancy was known as a loving and dedicated mother. But her family says her mental health began to decline after the birth of her third child. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Parents thrilled as 'bike gang' gets young boys off the couch
item.description: Some boys in regional South Australia are changing what it means to be in a bike gang, one pedal at a time. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Third woman engages lawyer over 'incredibly traumatic' Sydney Swans scandal
item.description: A lawyer representing a third woman involved in the Sydney Swans scandal says a potential civil lawsuit is being looked at. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: First-of-its-kind state funeral to be held in Bendigo for Russell Jack
item.description: Russell Jack established the famous Golden Dragon Museum to ensure traditions brought to the Bendigo goldfields by Chinese Australians were remembered. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: TikTok to pay $559m in 'one of the largest' child pivacy settlements
item.description: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia obligará a las grandes tecnológicas a pagar a los medios por usar sus contenidos
item.description: El Parlamento aprobó una ley que aplicará una tasa del 2,5% sobre los ingresos publicitarios de plataformas como Google, Meta, TikTok y LinkedIn si no alcanzan acuerdos comerciales con medios locales Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.title: Japan executes man convicted of killing five in pachinko fire
item.description: A man who killed five people by setting fire to a pachinko parlour in Osaka in 2009 has been hanged in Japan's first execution by Sanae Takaichi's government. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Australia wins the toss, bowls first as it looks for response against Bangladesh
item.description: Pat Cummins gets in on the act after Mitch Starc tore through the Bangladesh top order with five wickets in 22 balls, leaving the tourists floundering early on day one of the second Test. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Lions coach 'feels sorry' for Swans as likely finals clash looms
item.description: Brisbane Lions coach Chris Fagan describes the Sydney Swans scandal as a "head-scratcher", with the two teams likely to meet in the AFL qualifying final. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: From Nhulunbuy to New York, the rare politician torn between two worlds
item.description: From Arnhem Land to Northern Territory parliament, independent MLA Yiŋiya Guyula resigned from politics this week after taking his people's fight to the world. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
